# NuruShop

NuruShop is one of Kenya's leading online marketplaces for natural products,
organic foods, herbs, spices, essential oils, healthy living products and
faith-based literature.

Website:
https://www.nurushop.co.ke

Main Categories:

- Natural Products
- Organic Foods
- Herbs and Spices
- Essential Oils
- Health Reform Products
- Christian Literature

Popular Products:

- Flax Seeds
- Turmeric Powder
- Himalayan Pink Salt
- Garlic Powder
- Hibiscus Powder
- Peanut Butter
- Soya Products
